pet_notes: Clippy, the classic friendly silver paperclip assistant: thick smooth silver wire in a double-loop paperclip silhouette, two large attached white physical eyes with dark pupils and attached expressive dark eyebrows. No hands, feet, paper, or other props. Lower wire loop is the grounded base; upper wire bends naturally. Maintain intentional negative-space openings between wire loops.
